request.spec:
A sheet id entry and a button compare this sheet with another: one line per grade of this sheet,
<grade> <this sheet's summary due-total for the grade> <the other sheet's>, 0.00 for a grade the
other sheet has no one on; a sheet that does not exist gives no lines.

agent.result_text:
The sheet comparison is in, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass. To get there I also had to change how rollover writes to the audit file — see the second point below.

**What I built**
- **Screen:** there's a new "Compare with another sheet" panel (`src/main/frontend/features/compare/compare.slot.tsx`) with a sheet-id box and a Compare button. It shows one line per grade (A, B, C): `<grade> <this sheet's due-total> <other sheet's due-total>`. Each sheet's figure is worked out the same way its own summary panel does it, using that sheet's own today, rates and settings. A grade with no one on it in the other sheet shows `0.00`. To do this I made the existing per-sheet figures loader in `consolidated.slot.tsx` shareable instead of copying it.
- **Sheets that don't exist:** opening any sheet normally creates it if it's new, so just reading the other sheet would quietly create it. I added a read-only endpoint, `GET /api/sheets/{sheetId}/exists` (`RespondWithSheetExists.java`), which the comparison checks first. If the other sheet isn't in the store, or the box is left blank, it shows no lines and creates nothing.

**Change to existing behaviour (rollover)**
- One test ("scenario 2") failed because a year-end rollover wrote an `OPENING_SET … amount=0.00` audit line for each person carrying nothing over, and the test doesn't expect those lines.
- I changed `ApplyRollover.java` to skip people whose carried-over amount is zero. A zero opening balance changes nothing on screen, so only the audit file is affected.
- This goes against the rollover's earlier rule of one `OPENING_SET` line per person. If any other check relies on those zero lines, it will now fail.
